summary: KB Financial Group Inc. (KB Financial Group) filed a Form 6-K reporting its preliminary operating results for the first half of fiscal year 2026, released during an earnings conference on July 23, 2026. The filing includes consolidated financial highlights for KB Financial Group, Kookmin Bank, and KB Securities Co., Ltd., presented under K-IFRS and subject to auditor review. Key figures show quarterly and year-over-year changes in operating revenue, net operating profit, and profit attributable to shareholders. This is a routine earnings disclosure of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation triggering any M&A, restructuring, or capital event.
